from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document to support classification."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or name of the judgment document")
    procedure_type: str | None = Field(description="The procedural stage and nature (e.g. '国家赔偿审查', '刑事二审', '执行异议')")
    subject_matter: str | None = Field(description="The core subject of the dispute (e.g. '监狱监管', '管辖权', '财产执行')")
    parties_roles: list[str] | None = Field(description="Key roles of parties mentioned (e.g. '赔偿请求人', '行政机关', '被告人')")
    laws_cited: list[str] | None = Field(description="Key laws referenced for basis (e.g. '国家赔偿法', '民事诉讼法', '刑法')")
    outcome_summary: str | None = Field(description="Brief description of the court's decision (e.g. '驳回', '维持原判', '准许撤回')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CaseDocumentInfo]
